blocks.zh: 11.1 Introduction / 導論
blocks.en: 11.1 Introduction

blocks.zh: 教學說明
blocks.en: Teaching Notes

blocks.zh: 本附錄定位
blocks.en: Purpose of This Appendix

blocks.zh: 本附錄提供無菌製造HVAC系統的補充工程設計資訊，專為工程師提供實用的計算與設計參考。
blocks.en: This appendix provides supplementary engineering design information for sterile manufacturing HVAC systems, giving engineers practical calculation and design references.

blocks.zh: 關鍵定位
blocks.en: Key Positioning

blocks.zh: 本附錄是第5章（HVAC主章）的技術補充，不是獨立文件。必須搭配第5章一起閱讀，才能完整理解HVAC設計要求。
blocks.en: This appendix is a technical supplement to Chapter 5 (the main HVAC chapter), not a stand-alone document. It must be read together with Chapter 5 to fully understand the HVAC design requirements.

blocks.zh: 更深入參考
blocks.en: Further Reference

blocks.zh: 如需更詳細的HVAC工程設計資訊，應參閱ISPE GPG: HVAC專門指南[28]，該指南涵蓋更廣泛的HVAC工程細節。
blocks.en: For more detailed HVAC engineering design information, refer to the ISPE GPG: HVAC specialist guide [28], which covers HVAC engineering in much greater depth.

blocks.zh: 11.2 Sources of Particulate Contamination / 微粒污染來源
blocks.en: 11.2 Sources of Particulate Contamination

blocks.zh: 11.2.1 Internal Sources / 內部來源
blocks.en: 11.2.1 Internal Sources

blocks.zh: 人員粒子散發
blocks.en: Particle Shedding by Personnel

blocks.zh: 粒子產生率 (Particle Generation Rate)
blocks.en: Particle Generation Rate

blocks.zh: 人員是潔淨室中最大的污染源。粒子產生率隨活動強度變化巨大：
blocks.en: Personnel are the largest source of contamination in a cleanroom. The particle generation rate varies enormously with activity level:

blocks.zh: 靜止不動：約100,000粒子/分鐘
blocks.en: Motionless: approx. 100,000 particles/minute

blocks.zh: 頭部與手臂移動：約500,000粒子/分鐘
blocks.en: Head and arm movement: approx. 500,000 particles/minute
Walking: approx. 5,000,000 particles/minute
Fast walking: approx. 7,500,000-10,000,000 particles/minute

blocks.zh: 粒子散發資料的應用
blocks.en: Using Particle Shedding Data

blocks.zh: 圖11.1僅為單一數據點。在實際設計中應：
blocks.en: Figure 11.1 is only a single data point. In actual design you should:

blocks.zh: 參考多項研究數據
blocks.en: Refer to multiple sets of study data

blocks.zh: 考量防護服製造商的测試報告
blocks.en: Take into account test reports from the garment manufacturer

blocks.zh: 建立穩健的污染假設作為設計基礎
blocks.en: Establish robust contamination assumptions as the basis of design

blocks.zh: 設計用粒子產生率 = f(人員數, 活動強度, 防護服類型)
blocks.en: Design particle generation rate = f(number of personnel, activity level, garment type)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像人員就像在潔淨室中的「移動塑塵源」。靜止時只是慢慢漏出灰塵，但一旦動起來，就像搖動一個灰塵撲簿 — 粒子量飆升50–100倍。這就是為何無菌區內動作必須緩慢、受控。
blocks.en: Think of a person in a cleanroom as a "moving dust source". Standing still, they only leak dust slowly, but once they move it is like shaking a feather duster: the particle count jumps 50-100 times. This is why movements in the aseptic area must be slow and controlled.

blocks.zh: 設計重點
blocks.en: Design Focus

blocks.zh: 圖11.2以操作員周圍空間作為最差案例來建模。這是因為靠近人員處的粒子濃度最高，也是監測時最可能超標的位置。
blocks.en: Figure 11.2 models the space around the operator as the worst case. This is because particle concentration is highest close to personnel, and it is also the location where monitoring is most likely to exceed limits.

blocks.zh: 11.2.2 External Sources / 外部來源
blocks.en: 11.2.2 External Sources

blocks.zh: 外氣微粒與過濾策略
blocks.en: Outside Air Particles and Filtration Strategy

blocks.zh: HEPA過濾效率
blocks.en: HEPA Filter Efficiency

blocks.zh:
HEPA捕獲效率 ≥ 99.97%  (針對 0.3 μm MPPS粒子)

有效粒子滿透率 = 1 - 0.9997 = 0.03%

例：若外氣 = 10,000,000 粒子/m³
通過HEPA後 ≤ 3,000 粒子/m³
blocks.en:
HEPA capture efficiency ≥ 99.97%  (for 0.3 µm MPPS particles)

Effective particle penetration = 1 - 0.9997 = 0.03%

Example: if outside air = 10,000,000 particles/m³
after the HEPA filter ≤ 3,000 particles/m³

blocks.zh: 多級過濾策略 (Multi-Stage Filtration)
blocks.en: Multi-Stage Filtration Strategy

blocks.zh: 良好工程實務(GEP)要求多級過濾：
blocks.en: Good Engineering Practice (GEP) calls for multi-stage filtration:

blocks.zh: 粗效過濾器(G4/M5)：捕獲大粒子，保護中效過濾器
blocks.en: Coarse filter (G4/M5): captures large particles and protects the medium-efficiency filter

blocks.zh: 中效過濾器(F7/F9)：捕獲細粒子，延長HEPA壽命
blocks.en: Medium-efficiency filter (F7/F9): captures fine particles and extends HEPA life

blocks.zh: HEPA(H13/H14)：最終過濾，確保潔淨度
blocks.en: HEPA (H13/H14): final filtration, ensuring cleanliness

blocks.zh: 粗效過濾器捕獲大部分質量，顯著延長HEPA的使用壽命。
blocks.en: The coarse filter captures most of the dust mass and significantly extends the service life of the HEPA filter.

blocks.zh: EPA PM2.5數據應用
blocks.en: Using EPA PM2.5 Data

blocks.zh: 美國EPA的PM2.5數據可作為外氣0.5μm粒子濃度的參考指標。在高污染地區（如工業區、主幹道旁），應增強前置過濾級數，並縮短濾網更換週期。
blocks.en: US EPA PM2.5 data can serve as a reference indicator for the 0.5 µm particle concentration in outside air. In heavily polluted areas (such as industrial zones or next to arterial roads), the number of pre-filtration stages should be increased and the filter replacement interval shortened.

blocks.zh: 外氣比例影響
blocks.en: Effect of Outside Air Fraction

blocks.zh: 圖11.4的關鍵結論：在適當過濾下，外氣比例對潔淨室性能影響很小。這意味著：
blocks.en: The key conclusion of Figure 11.4: with appropriate filtration, the outside air fraction has little effect on cleanroom performance. This means:

blocks.zh: 設計重點應放在過濾品質，而非減少外氣
blocks.en: Design effort should focus on filtration quality, not on reducing outside air

blocks.zh: 適當的外氣量對於通風與壓差控制仍然重要
blocks.en: An adequate outside air volume remains important for ventilation and pressure differential control

blocks.zh: 預過濾的經濟效益遠大於減少外氣的節省
blocks.en: The economic benefit of pre-filtration far outweighs the savings from reducing outside air

blocks.zh: 11.3 HVAC Design Principles / HVAC設計原理
blocks.en: 11.3 HVAC Design Principles

blocks.zh: 11.3.1 Dilution versus Displacement Designs / 稀釋與置換設計比較
blocks.en: 11.3.1 Dilution versus Displacement Designs

blocks.zh: 兩種通風策略的核心差異
blocks.en: Core Differences Between the Two Ventilation Strategies

blocks.zh: 稀釋通風 (Dilution Ventilation)
blocks.en: Dilution Ventilation

blocks.zh: 原理：以亂流方式將乾淨空氣與房間髒空氣混合，降低整體粒子濃度。
blocks.en: Principle: clean air is mixed turbulently with dirty room air, lowering the overall particle concentration.

blocks.zh: 適用：ISO 7/Grade B及以下
blocks.en: Application: ISO 7/Grade B and below

blocks.zh: 換氣次數：通常20–60 ACH
blocks.en: Air change rate: typically 20-60 ACH

blocks.zh: 成本：相對較低
blocks.en: Cost: relatively low

blocks.zh: 限制：無法達到ISO 5級別
blocks.en: Limitation: cannot achieve ISO 5

blocks.zh: 置換通風 (Displacement Ventilation)
blocks.en: Displacement Ventilation

blocks.zh: 原理：以單向流(UAF)推送乾淨空氣，將髒空氣向下或向外推離。
blocks.en: Principle: clean air is delivered as unidirectional airflow (UAF), pushing dirty air downward or outward.

blocks.zh: 適用：ISO 5/Grade A 關鍵區域
blocks.en: Application: ISO 5/Grade A critical zones

blocks.zh: 換氣次數：數百次/小時
blocks.en: Air change rate: hundreds of changes per hour

blocks.zh: 成本：高資本與高營運成本
blocks.en: Cost: high capital and operating cost

blocks.zh: 優勢：能達到最高潔淨級別
blocks.en: Advantage: can achieve the highest cleanliness classification

blocks.zh: 比喻：清水與髒水
blocks.en: Analogy: Clean Water and Dirty Water

blocks.zh: 稀釋通風：就像將乾淨水不斷倒入混濁的水池中，攤拌混合後整體變得比較乾淨。
blocks.en: Dilution ventilation: like continuously pouring clean water into a cloudy pool; after stirring and mixing, the whole pool becomes cleaner.

blocks.zh: 置換通風：就像從水池一端持續注入乾淨水，將髒水從另一端推出去 — 乾淨區與髒區分明。
blocks.en: Displacement ventilation: like injecting clean water continuously at one end of the pool and pushing the dirty water out the other end, so the clean zone and the dirty zone stay clearly separated.

blocks.zh: 混合流房間 (Mixed Flow Room)
blocks.en: Mixed Flow Room

blocks.zh: 實際應用中最常見的是「混合流」設計：以亂流稀釋維持背景環境（如ISO 7），同時在關鍵位置設置單向流裝置(UAF)提供ISO 5保護。
blocks.en: The most common design in practice is the "mixed flow" design: turbulent dilution maintains the background environment (e.g. ISO 7), while unidirectional airflow (UAF) devices at critical locations provide ISO 5 protection.

blocks.zh: 死角區域警告
blocks.en: Warning: Dead Zones

blocks.zh: 稀釋系統必須識別空氣流動不足的區域（如房間角落），這些區域可能形成高粒子濃度的「死角」。關鍵製程操作絕對不能設在這些位置。
blocks.en: A dilution system must identify areas with insufficient airflow (such as room corners), which can become "dead zones" with high particle concentration. Critical process operations must never be located in these positions.

blocks.zh: 高位回風口不建議使用 — 會破壞房間內的氣流模式。
blocks.en: High-level return grilles are not recommended, because they disrupt the airflow pattern in the room.

blocks.zh: UAF罩對房間ACR的貢獻
blocks.en: Contribution of UAF Hoods to Room ACR

blocks.zh: 有效換氣次數計算
blocks.en: Calculating the Effective Air Change Rate

blocks.zh:
有效ACR = HVAC供氣ACR + UAF罩ACR貢獻

例：
  房間體積 = 100 m³
  HVAC供氣 = 3,000 m³/hr → 30 ACH
  UAF罩出風 = 1,500 m³/hr → +15 ACH
  有效ACR = 45 ACH
blocks.en:
Effective ACR = HVAC supply ACR + UAF hood ACR contribution

Example:
  Room volume = 100 m³
  HVAC supply = 3,000 m³/hr → 30 ACH
  UAF hood discharge = 1,500 m³/hr → +15 ACH
  Effective ACR = 45 ACH

blocks.zh: 設計原則
blocks.en: Design Principles

blocks.zh: 新設計應確保僅靠HVAC系統即可滿足最低ACR
blocks.en: New designs should ensure that the HVAC system alone meets the minimum ACR

blocks.zh: UAF罩的貢獻視為額外安全裡益
blocks.en: The UAF hood contribution is treated as an additional safety margin

blocks.zh: 不需所有供氣都經過冷加熱盤管 — 只需HEPA過濾即可
blocks.en: Not all supply air needs to pass through the cooling/heating coils; HEPA filtration alone is sufficient

blocks.zh: 恢復測試可在UAF罩開啟或關閉狀態下進行
blocks.en: Recovery testing may be performed with the UAF hoods on or off

blocks.zh: 11.3.2 Dilution System Design / 稀釋系統設計
blocks.en: 11.3.2 Dilution System Design

blocks.zh: 稀釋系統四大基本要求
blocks.en: Four Basic Requirements of a Dilution System

blocks.zh: 低位回風的重要性
blocks.en: Importance of Low-Level Returns

blocks.zh: 如果回風口設在高處，可能直接抽走剛送入的乾淨空氣，而髒空氣仍留在作業區。煙霧測試可以清楚視覺化這個問題。
blocks.en: If the return is located high up, it may draw away the clean air that has just been supplied while dirty air remains in the work area. A smoke test can make this problem clearly visible.

blocks.zh: 決定風量的四個因素
blocks.en: Four Factors That Determine Airflow

blocks.zh:
實際風量 = max(Q_thermal, Q_exhaust, Q_particle, Q_recovery)

其中：
  Q_thermal  = 抵銷熱負荷所需風量
  Q_exhaust  = 滲氣與排氣補充量
  Q_particle = 抵銷粒子產生所需風量
  Q_recovery = 滿足恢復時間所需風量
blocks.en:
Actual airflow = max(Q_thermal, Q_exhaust, Q_particle, Q_recovery)

Where:
  Q_thermal  = airflow required to offset the heat load
  Q_exhaust  = makeup for leakage and exhaust air
  Q_particle = airflow required to offset particle generation
  Q_recovery = airflow required to meet the recovery time

blocks.zh: 取四者最大值作為設計風量。
blocks.en: Take the largest of the four as the design airflow.

blocks.zh: FDA對ISO 8的ACR建議
blocks.en: FDA Recommendation on ACR for ISO 8

blocks.zh: FDA建議ISO 8潔淨室採用20 ACH，但這不是絕對數字。實際設計必須根據上述四個因素計算，最終ACR可能高於或低於20。
blocks.en: FDA recommends 20 ACH for ISO 8 cleanrooms, but this is not an absolute figure. The actual design must be calculated from the four factors above, and the final ACR may be higher or lower than 20.

blocks.zh: 恢復時間的商業價值
blocks.en: Commercial Value of Recovery Time

blocks.zh: 恢復時間不僅是法規要求（EU GMP要求15–20分鐘），更是產能優化的關鍵。在輪班作業的工廠，每次恢復省下5分鐘，每天可多出30–60分鐘的生產時間。
blocks.en: Recovery time is not only a regulatory requirement (EU GMP calls for 15-20 minutes) but also a key to optimizing capacity. In a plant running shifts, every 5 minutes saved on each recovery gives 30-60 extra minutes of production time per day.

blocks.zh: 11.4 Calculation of Air Change Rate / 換氣次數計算
blocks.en: 11.4 Calculation of Air Change Rate

blocks.zh: 11.4.1 Particle Gain versus Air Change Rate / 粒子產生與換氣次數
blocks.en: 11.4.1 Particle Gain versus Air Change Rate

blocks.zh: 粒子補償風量計算
blocks.en: Calculating Airflow to Offset Particle Gain

blocks.zh: 基本公式 — 粒子補償風量
blocks.en: Basic Formula: Airflow to Offset Particle Gain

blocks.zh:
G (粒子/時間)
Q = ———————————————
     C_max (粒子/體積)

其中：
  Q     = 所需供氣風量 (m³/hr 或 ft³/min)
  G     = 粒子產生率 (粒子數/hr)
  C_max = 允許最大粒子濃度 (粒子數/m³)
blocks.en:
G (particles/time)
Q = ---------------------------
     C_max (particles/volume)

Where:
  Q     = required supply airflow (m³/hr or ft³/min)
  G     = particle generation rate (particles/hr)
  C_max = maximum allowable particle concentration (particles/m³)

blocks.zh: 兩個基本假設
blocks.en: Two Basic Assumptions

blocks.zh: 完美混合：供氣與房間空氣完全均勻混合
blocks.en: Perfect mixing: supply air mixes completely and uniformly with room air

blocks.zh: 供氣零粒子：經HEPA過濾的供氣含0.5μm粒子數≈0
blocks.en: Zero particles in supply air: HEPA-filtered supply air contains approximately zero 0.5 µm particles

blocks.zh: 實際中不可能達到完美混合，因此這是「第一近似」，提供最低ACR的參考值。
blocks.en: Perfect mixing cannot be achieved in practice, so this is a "first approximation" that gives a reference value for the minimum ACR.

blocks.zh: ACR基本公式
blocks.en: Basic ACR Formula

blocks.zh:
ACH = Q / V

其中：
  ACH = 換氣次數 (次/小時)
  Q   = 供氣風量 (m³/hr)
  V   = 房間體積 (m³)
blocks.en:
ACH = Q / V

Where:
  ACH = air change rate (changes/hour)
  Q   = supply airflow (m³/hr)
  V   = room volume (m³)

blocks.zh: 工作範例
blocks.en: Worked Example

blocks.zh:
已知：
  房間體積 = 1,000 ft³
  供氣風量 = 400 CFM

計算：
  Q (ft³/hr) = 400 × 60 = 24,000 ft³/hr
  ACH = 24,000 / 1,000 = 24 ACH

注意：此風量可能不足以滿足
房間冷卻需求，需與熱負荷
計算結果取大者。
blocks.en:
Given:
  Room volume = 1,000 ft³
  Supply airflow = 400 CFM

Calculation:
  Q (ft³/hr) = 400 × 60 = 24,000 ft³/hr
  ACH = 24,000 / 1,000 = 24 ACH

Note: this airflow may not be enough to meet
the room cooling requirement; take the larger
of this and the heat load calculation result.

blocks.zh: 適用場景
blocks.en: Applicable Scenarios

blocks.zh: 此粒子補償計算特別適合：
blocks.en: This particle-offset calculation is particularly suitable for:

blocks.zh: 無菌區內的小房間（走廊、更衣室）
blocks.en: Small rooms within the aseptic area (corridors, gowning rooms)

blocks.zh: 人員密度相對較高的區域
blocks.en: Areas with relatively high personnel density

blocks.zh: 熱負荷不大但粒子產生顯著的場所
blocks.en: Locations with a small heat load but significant particle generation

blocks.zh: 11.4.2 Recovery Period versus Air Change Rates / 恢復期間與換氣次數
blocks.en: 11.4.2 Recovery Period versus Air Change Rates

blocks.zh: 恢復時間計算
blocks.en: Calculating Recovery Time

blocks.zh: 指數衰減模型
blocks.en: Exponential Decay Model

blocks.zh:
C(t) = C₀ × e^(-n × t)

其中：
  C(t) = t時刻的粒子濃度
  C₀   = 初始粒子濃度
  n    = 換氣次數 (ACH)
  t    = 時間 (小時)
  e    = 自然對數 ≈ 2.718
blocks.en:
C(t) = C₀ × e^(-n × t)

Where:
  C(t) = particle concentration at time t
  C₀   = initial particle concentration
  n    = air change rate (ACH)
  t    = time (hours)
  e    = base of natural logarithm ≈ 2.718

blocks.zh: 恢復時間公式
blocks.en: Recovery Time Formula

blocks.zh:
若需從 C₀ 恢復至 C_target：

         ln(C₀ / C_target)
t_rec = ————————————
              n

其中 ln 為自然對數
blocks.en:
To recover from C₀ to C_target:

         ln(C₀ / C_target)
t_rec = -------------------
              n

Where ln is the natural logarithm

blocks.zh: 工作範例：100倍恢復
blocks.en: Worked Example: 100-Fold Recovery

blocks.zh:
場景：從 ISO 7/Grade B 恢復至 ISO 5/Grade A
       需要100倍恢復 (粒子濃度降至1/100)

計算：
  ln(100) = 4.605

  當換氣次數 = 20 ACH：
  t = 4.605 / 20 = 0.230 hr = 13.8 min ≈ 14 min

  當換氣次數 = 30 ACH：
  t = 4.605 / 30 = 0.154 hr = 9.2 min ≈ 9 min

  當換氣次數 = 40 ACH：
  t = 4.605 / 40 = 0.115 hr = 6.9 min ≈ 7 min

  當換氣次數 = 60 ACH：
  t = 4.605 / 60 = 0.077 hr = 4.6 min ≈ 5 min
blocks.en:
Scenario: recovery from ISO 7/Grade B to ISO 5/Grade A
       requires a 100-fold recovery (particle concentration reduced to 1/100)

Calculation:
  ln(100) = 4.605

  At 20 ACH:
  t = 4.605 / 20 = 0.230 hr = 13.8 min ≈ 14 min

  At 30 ACH:
  t = 4.605 / 30 = 0.154 hr = 9.2 min ≈ 9 min

  At 40 ACH:
  t = 4.605 / 40 = 0.115 hr = 6.9 min ≈ 7 min

  At 60 ACH:
  t = 4.605 / 60 = 0.077 hr = 4.6 min ≈ 5 min

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：恢復優先於ACR
blocks.en: Key Principle: Recovery Takes Priority over ACR

blocks.zh: 達到目標恢復時間比達到目標換氣次數更重要。
blocks.en: Achieving the target recovery time is more important than achieving the target air change rate.

blocks.zh: 這意味著：
blocks.en: This means:

blocks.zh: ACR是手段，恢復時間是目的
blocks.en: ACR is the means; recovery time is the goal

blocks.zh: 如果混合效率高，較低的ACR也能達到目標恢復
blocks.en: If mixing efficiency is high, a lower ACR can still achieve the target recovery

blocks.zh: 如果混合效率差，即使高ACR也可能不達標
blocks.en: If mixing efficiency is poor, even a high ACR may fail to meet the target

blocks.zh: 練習：計算恢復時間
blocks.en: Exercise: Calculating Recovery Time

blocks.zh: 場景：一個ISO 8潔淨室，在操作期間粒子濃度升至標準的10倍。HVAC系統提供25 ACH。
blocks.en: Scenario: in an ISO 8 cleanroom, particle concentration rises to 10 times the standard during operation. The HVAC system provides 25 ACH.

blocks.zh: 計算恢復到標準需要多長時間？
blocks.en: How long does it take to recover to the standard?

blocks.zh: 如果需要在5分鐘內恢復，最低ACR應為多少？
blocks.en: If recovery is required within 5 minutes, what should the minimum ACR be?

blocks.zh: 11.5 Process Knowledge / 製程知識
blocks.en: 11.5 Process Knowledge

blocks.zh: HVAC設計必須的製程資訊
blocks.en: Process Information Required for HVAC Design

blocks.zh: 為何製程知識對HVAC設計至關重要？
blocks.en: Why Is Process Knowledge Essential to HVAC Design?

blocks.zh: HVAC系統不是獨立設計的 — 它必須圍繞製程需求來設計。製程知識決定：
blocks.en: An HVAC system is not designed in isolation; it must be designed around process requirements. Process knowledge determines:

blocks.zh: 需要何種級別的環境保護
blocks.en: What level of environmental protection is needed

blocks.zh: 污染風險在哪些步驟最高
blocks.en: Which steps carry the highest contamination risk

blocks.zh: 需要多少人員與多少干預
blocks.en: How many personnel and how many interventions are involved

blocks.zh: 設備的動態空氣影響
blocks.en: The dynamic air effects of the equipment

blocks.zh: 比喻：HVAC設計像量身訂做
blocks.en: Analogy: HVAC Design Is Like Tailoring

blocks.zh: HVAC設計就像量身訂做西裝 — 必須先知道穿者的體型（製程需求）、活動場合（無菌操作類型）、天氣（外部環境），才能設計出合適的系統。套用標準模板往往導致過度設計或不足。
blocks.en: HVAC design is like tailoring a suit: you must first know the wearer's build (process requirements), the occasion (type of aseptic operation) and the weather (external environment) before you can design a suitable system. Applying a standard template often leads to over-design or under-design.

blocks.zh: 人員介入對HVAC的直接影響
blocks.en: Direct Impact of Personnel Interventions on HVAC

blocks.zh: 11.5(c)的人員介入資訊直接影響：
blocks.en: The personnel intervention information in 11.5(c) directly affects:

blocks.zh: 粒子產生率估算（人數 × 活動強度）
blocks.en: Particle generation rate estimation (number of people × activity level)

blocks.zh: 換氣次數計算（必須抵銷粒子產生）
blocks.en: Air change rate calculation (must offset particle generation)

blocks.zh: UAF保護區配置（人員介入點需額外保護）
blocks.en: UAF protected zone configuration (intervention points need additional protection)

blocks.zh: 恢復時間需求（人員退出後的恢復速度）
blocks.en: Recovery time requirements (speed of recovery after personnel leave)

blocks.zh: 11.5.1 Sterilizer Types / 滅菌器類型
blocks.en: 11.5.1 Sterilizer Types

blocks.zh: 去熱原隧道與HVAC整合
blocks.en: Depyrogenation Tunnels and HVAC Integration

blocks.zh: 動態設備的挑戰
blocks.en: The Challenge of Dynamic Equipment

blocks.zh: 去熱原隧道(Depyrogenation Tunnel)是HVAC設計中最複雜的整合點之一，因為：
blocks.en: The depyrogenation tunnel is one of the most complex integration points in HVAC design, because:

blocks.zh: 隧道從房間抽取空氣，也向房間排放空氣
blocks.en: The tunnel draws air from the room and also discharges air to the room

blocks.zh: 風量隨運行狀態和溫度而變化
blocks.en: Airflow varies with operating state and temperature

blocks.zh: 開/關機與不同溫度條件下風量差異巨大
blocks.en: Airflow differs enormously between start-up/shut-down and different temperature conditions

blocks.zh: 理想氣體定律與密度變化
blocks.en: Ideal Gas Law and Density Change

blocks.zh:
PV = nRT

在恒壓條件下：
  V ∝ T  (體積與溫度成正比)

加熱區 (~350°C = 623K)
冷卻區 (~25°C = 298K)

密度比 = 623/298 ≈ 2.09

意味：冷卻區空氣密度約為
加熱區的2倍，相同質量流率
下體積流率差異巨大。
blocks.en:
PV = nRT

At constant pressure:
  V ∝ T  (volume is proportional to temperature)

Heating zone (~350°C = 623 K)
Cooling zone (~25°C = 298 K)

Density ratio = 623/298 ≈ 2.09

This means: air density in the cooling zone is
about twice that of the heating zone, so at the same
mass flow rate the volumetric flow rates differ greatly.

blocks.zh: 壓差逆轉風險
blocks.en: Risk of Pressure Differential Reversal

blocks.zh: 如果未充分考慮隧道動態風量變化，可能導致：
blocks.en: If the dynamic airflow of the tunnel is not adequately considered, the following may result:

blocks.zh: 無菌區與鄰接區域之間壓差消失或逆轉
blocks.en: Pressure differential between the aseptic area and adjacent areas is lost or reversed

blocks.zh: 產生反向氣流，將污染空氣帶入無菌區
blocks.en: Reverse airflow is created, carrying contaminated air into the aseptic area

blocks.zh: 嚴重的GMP合規問題
blocks.en: A serious GMP compliance issue

blocks.zh: 必須針對隧道的各種運行狀態進行穩定化措施設計。
blocks.en: Stabilization measures must be designed for every operating state of the tunnel.

blocks.zh: 高溫HEPA過濾器限制
blocks.en: Limitations of High-Temperature HEPA Filters

blocks.zh: 傳統高溫HEPA濾網耐溫上限為250°C，但許多去熱原隧道操作溫度遠高於此。一旦濾網被「燒過」：
blocks.en: Conventional high-temperature HEPA filters have an upper temperature limit of 250°C, but many depyrogenation tunnels operate well above this. Once a filter has been "burned":

blocks.zh: 濾材黏合劑開始分解
blocks.en: The filter media binder begins to decompose

blocks.zh: 濾網無法通過洩漏測試掃描
blocks.en: The filter cannot pass leak test scanning

blocks.zh: 需要替代方法驗證熱區粒子水平
blocks.en: Alternative methods are needed to verify particle levels in the hot zone

blocks.zh: 新型高溫HEPA濾網聲稱可耐更高溫度並支持持續洩漏測試，但應謹慎驗證。
blocks.en: Newer high-temperature HEPA filters are claimed to withstand higher temperatures and support continuous leak testing, but they should be validated carefully.

blocks.zh: 資格確認階段的關鍵考量
blocks.en: Key Considerations During Qualification

blocks.zh: 對隧道進行體積流量測量時，必須記錄：
blocks.en: When measuring volumetric flow on the tunnel, the following must be recorded:

blocks.zh: 測量位置（加熱區/冷卻區/進料端/出料端）
blocks.en: Measurement location (heating zone/cooling zone/infeed end/outfeed end)

blocks.zh: 測量條件（開機/關機、運行溫度）
blocks.en: Measurement conditions (on/off, operating temperature)

blocks.zh: 實際空氣溫度（影響密度與體積流率）
blocks.en: Actual air temperature (affects density and volumetric flow rate)

blocks.zh: Section Summary / 章節摘要
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 摘要（中文）
blocks.en: Summary
Key Points: Appendix 1a (11.1-11.5)

blocks.zh: 核心原則
blocks.en: Core Principles

blocks.zh: 人員是第一大污染源 — 粒子產生率隨活動強度變化50–100倍。建立穩健的污染假設是潔淨室設計的關鍵第一步。
blocks.en: Personnel are the number one source of contamination: the particle generation rate varies 50-100 times with activity level. Establishing robust contamination assumptions is the critical first step in cleanroom design.

blocks.zh: 外部粒子可管理 — 在適當多級過濾下，外氣比例對潔淨室性能影響極小。
blocks.en: External particles can be managed: with appropriate multi-stage filtration, the outside air fraction has very little effect on cleanroom performance.

blocks.zh: 兩種通風策略 — 稀釋通風適用ISO 7及以下；置換通風用於ISO 5/Grade A。大多數設施採用混合流設計。
blocks.en: Two ventilation strategies: dilution ventilation is suitable for ISO 7 and below; displacement ventilation is used for ISO 5/Grade A. Most facilities adopt a mixed flow design.

blocks.zh: 四個因素決定風量 — 熱負荷、排氣需求、粒子抵銷、恢復時間，取最大值為設計基礎。
blocks.en: Four factors determine airflow: heat load, exhaust requirements, particle offset and recovery time; the maximum is the design basis.

blocks.zh: 恢復時間優先於ACR — 達到目標恢復時間比达到特定換氣次數更重要。
blocks.en: Recovery time takes priority over ACR: achieving the target recovery time is more important than achieving a specific air change rate.

blocks.zh: 製程知識驅動HVAC設計 — 五大類製程資訊（產品流、容器流、人員介入、設備、一般項目）缺一不可。
blocks.en: Process knowledge drives HVAC design: all five categories of process information (product flow, container flow, personnel interventions, equipment, general items) are indispensable.

blocks.zh: 動態設備是關鍵 — 去熱原隧道的變動空氣需求可能破壞壓差，必須進行穩定化設計。
blocks.en: Dynamic equipment is critical: the variable air demand of depyrogenation tunnels can upset pressure differentials, so stabilization must be designed in.

blocks.en: Self-Assessment Questions

blocks.en: What are the two basic assumptions behind the simplified ACR calculation?
